popCulture.title: Las Hilanderas
popCulture.creator: Diego Velázquez
popCulture.description: Velázquez's Prado canvas folds Arachne's contest into a tapestry workshop — Athena's wrath as Baroque meta-painting.

popCulture.title: Arachne
popCulture.description: The Lydian weaver turned spider remains the emblem of craft that rivals the gods — and of arachnid etymology itself.

popCulture.title: Hades II

popCulture.description: Supergiant's sequel brings Arachne into Melinoë's path — the spider-woman as ally and reminder of Athena's curse.
